itemList.description: Providing, Fabricating, Supplying and Painting overall size of 1800 mm length X 1200 mm height MS Barricade. The outer structural frame shall be made of 50X50X4 mm MS square pipe of 4mm thickness. fully welded to form a rigid rectangular structure. The internal horizontal and vertical members, including base bracing and stiffeners, shall be constructed using 30X30X3.2mm MS square pipe of 3.2 mm thickness, welded as per the approved design to ensure adequate strength and stability. The central infill panel shall consist of a 2.0 mm thick mild steel sheet, securely welded to the frame, with the bottom edge kept slightly inclined as shown in the drawing. The barricade shall be mounted on 5 Inch Heavy Duty Caster Set of 4, Swivel Castor Wheels with Dual Locking Brakes, Silent Polyurethane (PU) Wheels, fixed to the bottom frame through welded MS brackets to allow smooth movement and easy handling. Each wheel shall have a minimum load-bearing capacity of 2800lbs, ensuring durability and stability during operation. All welding joints shall be ground smooth, and all sharp edges and burrs shall be removed to ensure safe handling. Followed by the application of one coat of red oxide or zinc chromate primer. Finishing shall be done with two coats of Asian enamel paint in yellow color with Retro-Reflective Customized High-Intensity / Premium Grade of 3M / Avery Dennison Safety signage/Slogan boards of Size 900X600mm Printed on ACP sheet of 3mm and to be riveted/bolted on both sides of Barricade center MS Plate.
